title: Image field
summary: A form field for one image: a thumbnail with the file name and size, «Заменить…» and «Убрать», a file dropped anywhere on it replaces the image; label, help, error, required, disabled and read-only as every field has them. It raises the chosen File; the host uploads it.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

name.description: The form name the chosen file is submitted under, by the platform file input inside.

label.description: The field label above the image; it names the group. Without it the group is named «Изображение» / Image.

hint.description: Help text under the field; slot `hint` takes markup instead.

accept.description: What the file dialog offers and a drop accepts: `.ext`, `type/*` or `type/sub`, comma separated.

size.description: Field size: 1/2, 1 or 2, as every form field.

meta.description: The line under the name; by default the image's dimensions once it loads and its size («450×300 · 2 КБ»).

empty-text.description: The words of the empty field; «Изображение не выбрано» / No image chosen by default.

required.description: The field must hold an image: the platform input is required while it is empty, so a form will not submit without one.

disabled.description: Shown and not changed: the buttons are disabled and a drop is refused.

readonly.description: Shown without buttons; a drop is refused.

invalid.description: The error state: the edge and the message take the error colour and the group carries aria-invalid.

error-message.description: The error shown in place of the hint while the field is invalid; slot `error` takes markup instead.

aria-label.description: The group's accessible name when no label is drawn inside the field: a form that prints the label beside it (the Framework's field renderers) names the field without a second, visible label.

error.description: The error state; the same as invalid.

value.description: The image in the file shape {value, label, mime, size, href, file?}, or null; the attribute takes an address or the shape as JSON

clear.summary: Empty the field from code; the same as setValue(null). Returns the element.

choose.summary: Open the file dialog, as «Заменить…» and «Выбрать…» do. Returns false when the field is disabled or read-only.

removeImage.summary: Remove the image as the person would with «Убрать»: input, change and sf-image-field-detach fire, focus goes to «Выбрать…». Returns whether there was an image to remove.

takeFile.summary: Take a File as the person would by choosing it (source input, drop or another the host names): the thumbnail shows it from an object URL and input, change and sf-image-field-attach fire. A file the accept list does not name is rejected instead. Returns whether it was taken.

setError.summary: Show an error message and the invalid state, or clear both with an empty message. Writes error-message and invalid. Returns the element.

setValue.summary: Set the image from code, in the file shape or as an address; null empties the field. Fires nothing, as a value set from code is not a change. Returns the element.

change.summary: The image was chosen, dropped or removed: once per change the person made, a CustomEvent on the host carrying the value, the File and the form name. The platform input's own change does not leave the host.

value.description: The new value in the file shape; a chosen file carries `file` and an object URL in `href` until the host writes the stored value. null after a removal.

file.description: The File chosen, or null after a removal.

input.summary: Sent with every change, before it, with the same detail, as a native file input sends input and change together.

value.description: The new value in the file shape; a chosen file carries `file` and an object URL in `href` until the host writes the stored value. null after a removal.

file.description: The File chosen, or null after a removal.

sf-input-image-attach.summary: A file was chosen or dropped: the File to upload. The host uploads it and sets the stored value. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-image-field:select follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-input-image-detach.summary: The person removed the image; detail carries the value it held. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-image-field:remove follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-input-image-rejected.summary: Files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them; announced politely. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-image-field:reject follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-image-field:select.summary: A file was chosen or dropped: the File to upload. The host uploads it and sets the stored value. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-attach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-image-field:remove.summary: The person removed the image; detail carries the value it held. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-detach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-image-field:reject.summary: Files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them; announced politely. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-rejected with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

forbidden_client_responsibilities: choosing where the file is stored

accessibility.focus: A group named by the field label and described by the help or error text. «Заменить…», «Убрать» and «Выбрать…» are real buttons named for what they act on («Заменить изображение «logo.png»»); the thumbnail's alt is the file name. The drop target takes no focus, so it is never a stop or a trap. After a removal focus goes to «Выбрать…». A choice, a removal and a refused file are announced in a polite status.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-image for a form value that is one image -- a logo, a cover, a picture in a block -- shown, replaced and removed in place.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for several files or a transfer list: that is sf-file-upload
Do not expect it to upload: it raises the File and the host uploads it
